data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for retrieving the Android ID on Android devices.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to retrieve the unique Android ID string for the device. Returns null on non-Android platforms.
use_when: You need to retrieve the Android ID for analytics or non-advertising tracking
You are building an Android-specific application or feature requiring device identifiers
avoid_when: You need a cross-platform solution for getting unique device identifiers
You require guaranteed uniqueness across factory resets or app signing key changes
strengths: Gracefully returns null on non-Android platforms instead of throwing exceptions
weaknesses: Only works on Android; returns null on iOS, Web, and other platforms
Android ID is not globally unique on Android 8+ (it depends on the app-signing key, user, and device)
data.setup_notes: Requires Android API 24 or newer and Java 17+
